summary: Amax Exploration, Inc. objected to permits being required for miners under the proposed ORV regulations. Their comment was one of at least 15 responses from mining interests concerned about the application of Executive Order 11644 to mining vehicles. As a result of these mining industry objections, the Department revised its final statement to except mining, oil, and gas geophysical exploration equipment from the definition of off-road vehicles.
